<!--
Thanks for the suggestion! You don't need to know how it would be built.
Explaining the problem you're trying to solve is the most helpful part.
Please remove any personal or financial information from examples.
-->

## Problem or opportunity
What are you trying to do, and what makes it difficult today?

## Proposed improvement
What would you like to see? Rough ideas are welcome.

## Example use case
Walk us through a situation where this would help.

## Alternatives considered
Have you tried any workarounds or other tools?

## Additional context
Screenshots, mock-ups, links or anything else that helps explain the idea.
